name: Savitribai Jyotirao Phule Fellowship For Single Girl Child

rules.value: female (single girl child of her parents)
rules.quote: Any single girl child of her parents pursuing Ph.D. in any stream/subject in recognised Universities/Colleges/ Institutes is eligible to apply under the scheme.
Fellowship is available for pursuing research work leading to award of Ph.D degree
pursuing Ph.D. in any stream/subject in recognised Universities/Colleges/ Institutes

rules.value: tenure up to PhD thesis submission or 5 years, whichever earlier
rules.quote: Fellowship will be granted upto the date of submission of Ph.D. Thesis or 5 years of tenure whichever is earlier.

rules.value: slots decided yearly on eligible online applications
rules.quote: The number of slots for fellowship will be decided every year on the basis of eligible applications complete in all respects, received through online mode.

amount.text: JRF Rs 37,000 pm for 2 years; SRF Rs 42,000 pm for remaining period; contingency Rs 10,000/20,500 pa (Humanities & Social Sciences) or Rs 12,000/25,000 pa (Science)
amount.quote: JRF @Rs. 37,000/-pm for 2 years SRF @Rs. 42,000/- pm for remaining period

deadline.text: Not stated; applications online through the UGC fellowship portal
